verdict.rationale: Canva's own docs say its MCP server can create designs from text descriptions and apply targeted edits to existing designs through natural-language commands, and they mention a 'Canva AI' that designs with pasted context. The evidence frames this mainly as access through external AI assistants, and it is thin on what the tool actually produces. missing for 10: documentation of in-editor prompt-to-design generation for designers, specifics on first drafts, layouts, or full mockups and their output quality, and independent or hands-on corroboration that generated designs are usable.

support.subject: As a designer, I can generate or edit designs from a natural-language prompt — first drafts, layouts, or full mockups the tool actually produces

citations.quote: Create designs programmatically from text descriptions and specifications
Apply targeted modifications to existing designs through natural language commands
give your users access to Canva's design capabilities through natural language, directly from the AI tools they already use
Bring content into Canva AI by pasting links from other platforms to design with more context.
